name: OpenCode Zen
short: OpenCode's model gateway — 122 tracked models ship under `opencode/` ids, several with free tiers and a Go subscription plan.

plans.name: Free tier
plans.notes: Thirteen limited-time free IDs as of 2026-11-10: GLM-5.3-Flash Free, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash Free, MiMo-V2.6-Flash Free, Nemotron 3 Ultra / 3.5 Lightning / 3.5 Super VL Free, Big Pickle, Iceman Free, Inkling 2 Small Free, Beam Free, Flint 40B Free, LongCat 2.5 Free (100 requests/day) and Jev 1.13 Free. Some free endpoints log usage data (NVIDIA endpoints) or train on it (Inkling 2 Small); availability is labeled per model page.

plans.name: OpenCode Go plan
plans.notes: Selected models are free under the Go plan (e.g. Cat Jam).

plans.name: Pay-as-you-go
plans.notes: Each covered model page links the rate claiming its price. Sold at cost; a 4.6% + $0.31 processing fee applies to each credit purchase. Current promos: Gemini 4 Argon at 50% off (through 2026-11-30) and Gemini 3.8/3.7/3.6 Flash at 50% off (through 2026-12-31). Deprecated: DeepSeek V4 Flash (2026-10-26), MiniMax M2.5 and Kimi K2.5 (2026-08-05), Crouton Alpha Free (2026-11-09).
